main.inference_gate: Country land-climate availability only. Not GBIF observation-effort matched, not random sites of true butterfly dispersal, not a host/non-host local control, not demonstrated caterpillar use or establishment. Multiple source-positive cases and within-species country contrasts are posthoc descriptive.

result_interpretation: A geographic control against country-wide annual temperature/precipitation supply. Residual does not show host-enabled niche shifts, observer effort bias, caterpillar survival, plant use, temporal colonization or population change.
